title: Magic Missile RAW
description: Rules-as-written Magic Missile for dnd5e: one damage roll shared by every dart, upcast-aware dart counts, per-target dart allocation, per-dart damage application (separate concentration saves), Shield immunity, Empowered Evocation, and JB2A animations via Sequencer.

recommends.reason: Required for the JB2A missile animations.
Free JB2A animation pack (purple missiles). The Patreon pack (jb2a_patreon) unlocks the other colours.
